SiteSettings.title: SiteSettings
SiteSettings.description: Global settings for the website, like section visibility.

showHero.description: Whether to show the hero section.

showFeatures.description: Whether to show the features section.

showServices.description: Whether to show the services section.

showContact.description: Whether to show the contact section.

heroTitle.description: The main title in the hero section.

heroSubtitle.description: The subtitle in the hero section.

heroDescription.description: The description text in the hero section.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: A service offered by the company.

iconName.description: The name of the Lucide icon to use.

image.description: The URL of the image for the service.

isActive.description: Whether the service is currently active and visible.

order.description: The order in which the service should be displayed.

User.title: User
User.description: A user of the application, typically an admin.

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

role.description: The role of the user (admin or user).
